optimizedDescription.value: ConfigWriter initializes projects and mutates plugin declarations without coupling application code to filesystem or YAML.

optimizedContext.value:
# ConfigWriter

## Rules
- TypeScript interface `ConfigWriter`, not abstract class: `initProject`, `addPlugin`, `removePlugin`, `listPlugins`.
- `initProject(InitProjectOptions): Promise<InitProjectResult>`. Options: absolute `projectRoot`, `schemaRef`, `workspaceId`, relative `specsPath`, optional `force`. Result: absolute `configPath`, `schemaRef`, readonly workspaces, project-relative `metadataCachePath`.
- Initialize `specd.yaml` with schema/default workspace, omitting storage; create specs and `.specd/{changes,drafts,discarded,archive}`; ensure metadata cache. For default fs metadata only, append rooted `/.specd/metadata/` to root `.gitignore`.
- Create `{configPath}/tmp/.gitignore` idempotently with normative tmp-ignore contents. Add `specd.local.yaml` and `specd.local.*.yaml` ignores idempotently.
- Existing `specd.yaml` without force throws `AlreadyInitialisedError`; force overwrites.
- `addPlugin(configPath,type,name,config?)` adds unique `{name,config?}` under `plugins[type]`; `removePlugin` removes named entry; both return `Promise<void>`.
- `listPlugins(configPath,type?)` returns matching declarations or all categories; missing file/no declarations returns `[]`.
- Delivery obtains port through `createConfigWriter()` from `@specd/core`; never imports `FsConfigWriter`. Prefer existing `SpecdConfig` snapshot over `listPlugins` for reads.
- Validate only required configuration; optional plugin config remains absent unless supplied/required.

## Constraints
- Port lives `application/ports/`; no `node:fs`, yaml, or I/O dependency.
- `AlreadyInitialisedError` application-layer.
- Plugin shape: `{ agents: Array<{ name, config? }> }`.
